title: Generative AI-Driven Parametric Design Optimization Framework for Vehicle Closure Systems
abstract: arXiv:2611.20451v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This study presents a generative AI-driven parametric design optimization framework integrating performance-oriented generation with editable computer-aided design (CAD) and downstream computer-aided engineering (CAE) analysis for industrial vehicle closure systems. The framework is demonstrated on an automotive tailgate assembly with complex geometry, coupled components, and competing performance and feasibility requirements. A production-oriented CATIA model is restructured into a reference-based parametric template with a 13-dimensional design representation. An automated CAD/CAE workflow generates parametric models, performs structural analysis, and constructs a database of mass, maximum displacement, and maximum von Mises stress. Gaussian process regression surrogates predict performance, while diffusion and flow matching models generate design candidates. translated_title: 面向车辆开闭件系统的生成式AI驱动参数化设计优化框架
translated_abstract: 本研究提出了一种生成式AI驱动的参数化设计优化框架，该框架将面向性能的生成与可编辑的计算机辅助设计（CAD）以及下游的计算机辅助工程（CAE）分析相结合，应用于工业车辆开闭件系统。该框架在一个具有复杂几何形状、耦合部件以及相互竞争的性能与可行性要求的汽车尾门总成上进行了演示验证。研究将面向生产的CATIA模型重构为基于参考的参数化模板，采用13维设计表示。自动化的CAD/CAE工作流生成参数化模型、执行结构分析，并构建了包含质量、最大位移和最大von Mises应力的数据库。高斯过程回归代理模型用于性能预测，而扩散模型和流匹配模型用于生成设计候选方案。设计问题以最小化质量和最大位移为目标，同时对应力进行评估（作为约束条件）。
tldr: 该研究提出了一个生成式AI驱动的参数化设计优化框架，通过将生产级CATIA模型重构为参数化模板、构建自动化CAD/CAE工作流与数据库、结合高斯过程回归代理模型及扩散与流匹配生成模型，实现了汽车尾门等复杂车辆开闭件系统在质量与性能之间的自动化设计优化。
en_tdlr: This study presents a generative AI-driven parametric design optimization framework that integrates production-oriented CAD templates, automated CAD/CAE workflows, Gaussian process regression surrogates, and diffusion/flow matching generative models to optimize complex vehicle closure systems such as automotive tailgates for mass and performance.
